limitation: Settled case observations only. An absent parent receipt means the enclosing invocation is incomplete; this record neither certifies acceptance nor skips work.

children.stdout_observation_policy: Parent monotonic elapsed time when a flushed phase line was read; not exact event wall time. Nominal polling interval 0.25 seconds.
children.stdout_progress_policy: Relay only advancing observed shell cycles/counters to parent stdout, at most once per 30 seconds and once at settlement; at most 128 reports per child. Raw logs and phase observations remain authoritative. Progress is not completion and changes no timeout or acceptance rule.

compiler_storage_observation.limitation: Sampled allocated-file high-water mark, not an exact continuous peak. Filesystem availability includes other users.

compiler_storage_reservation.basis: Provisional conservative budget; not a measured peak

simulation_receipt.stdout_progress_policy: Relay only advancing observed shell cycles/counters to parent stdout, at most once per 30 seconds and once at settlement; at most 128 reports per child. scheduling.boot_compiler_peak_measurement: Pending compiler-storage probe; historical observations were insufficient
scheduling.policy: At most eight tool children; three CPU slots and 2 GiB memory per child. Provisional compiler transient and retained-growth reservations are rechecked at launch and shared by nested batches. Retained bytes remain on disk and affect every later launch. A storage guard failure cancels queued and active compilers for this invocation, even if cleanup restores headroom. Verilator compilation uses -j 2.

record.timeout_scope: Default per-child budget; child receipts record actual enforced limits
